sources.entry: FinderFix - Finally, a lasting solution for Finder windows size and position. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon].

summary.name: FinderFix
summary.one_liner: FinderFix is a macOS utility that makes Finder windows open at the size and position you set.
keywords: cut and paste finder cmd x
use_cases: Making Finder windows reopen at a fixed size and position
Adding some TotalFinder-style features without disabling SIP
Using cut and paste shortcuts in Finder
summary.what_it_does: FinderFix is written in Swift as a universal binary for Apple silicon and Intel Macs. It aims to make every new Finder window open in the exact size and position the user chooses. The author describes it as faster than FinderMinder because it avoids slow AppleScript calls. It also ports some TotalFinder features, including cmd+X cut and paste in Finder, and works without disabling System Integrity Protection. The page says it is not yet a full TotalFinder replacement.
notable: Native Swift app built as an M1 Apple silicon universal binary
Works without disabling System Integrity Protection (SIP)
Ports some TotalFinder features such as cmd+X cut and paste
Intended as a modern, faster replacement for FinderMinder
caveats: Not yet a full replacement for TotalFinder
Page describes it as freeware but does not state license terms beyond that
